notes:
What's new in 0.9.243 (beta)
- Sign in, in plain words: without AI access GOAT says "Sign in" and shows the button; signing in turns the coach on straight away, no reload. Sign in and Settings share one panel.
- Your newest session first: the first start opens on your latest session; the sharing choice waits until you sign in.
- One GOAT window: starting GOAT again brings the open window to the front instead of opening a second one.
- Cleaner track map lines: your line no longer draws on the outside of tight apexes; AC Laguna Seca map refitted.
- SMART listens better: a word it cannot place gets "Say again?" instead of a guess (your commands always go through); you can dispute its last line in any mode; no "faster car behind" for a car you just passed.
- Fairer lap verdicts: a fastest lap with one wheel briefly over is "one wheel over at Turn N", not "an off".
- One reference: one reference lap across GOAT, re-ranked after a Virtual Best build.
- Setup advice stays advice: asking for setup advice never saves a file; only a change you ask for is written.
- Race highlights: overtakes, contact, spins, offs and best laps are always kept.
- Tidier header: one row, and no sideways scrolling on narrow windows.

Also in this build (from 0.9.242)
- Test setups after a practice run: on Assetto Corsa, when you stop after a run SMART can offer two or three test setups built from what it saw (springs, ride height, toe, rebound, camber); pick one by its letter or say yes, and only that one is saved. The offers also show on GOAT Dash.
- Every setup change said: SMART gives the reason for each change and names every change it makes; its base is your latest saved setup, and "go back" returns to your car's setup.
- Turbo boost dial: a BOOST overlay and a boost ring on GOAT Dash for turbo cars; hidden when the car has no boost.
- Turn time on the live track map: a "Turn time" tick box colours each turn by the time gained or lost against the reference, with the seconds beside it.
- Calmer brake coaching: a repeated braking mistake gets one call, on the next approach; "Brake." comes half a second earlier; no made-up brake-bias moves.
- SMART radio: one greeting per session, an off is named after its own corner, and after a long stop SMART checks in.
- Pit limit call: fires again after a return to the pits, a reset or a tow.
- Corner arrows: the arrow shape matches the corner speed.
